blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Rain or Shine coach Yeng Guiao commended the resolve put up by his team in completing a come-from-behind 124-120 win over Converge in Game 1 of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals. The Elasto Painters scrapped their way back from being down 21 early in the second quarter to secure the victory and draw first blood in their best-of-five series that is expected to be a rough-and-tumble one. “I think the most important thing in this win is just our playoff toughness,” said Guiao. “We made a lot of mistakes in the first half […]...
